title: Smooth balls don't go far ⛳
caption:
Turns out the dimples do all the work ⛳💨
Tag your golf buddy 👇
first_comment: Did you know why golf balls have dimples? ⛳👇
sources: NASA Glenn Research Center / US Golf Association: dimples trip the boundary layer to turbulence, delaying separation and reducing drag
Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'golf ball' (early smooth 'gutties' flew further once nicked; modern balls have about 300-500 dimples)
Bearman P. W. & Harvey J. K. (1976) 'Golf ball aerodynamics', Aeronautical Quarterly 27: 112-122 (a dimpled ball travels roughly twice as far as a smooth one)
